description: This file declares classes and methods related to container management, specifically for a 'CRunContainer' and its administrator within the WPEFramework's ProcessContainers namespace. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and external C library references for container operations.

classes.name: CRunContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via the crun library, providing methods to start, stop, and query container status, as well as retrieve system resource information.

classes.name: CRunContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages multiple CRunContainer instances, providing container creation, logging, and overall administration functionalities.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID associated with the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with a specified command and parameters.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, with a specified timeout.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Memory
methods.description: Retrieves memory information of the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Retrieves processor information of the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves network interface information of the container.

methods.name: CRunContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on ID, search paths, log path, and configuration.

methods.name: CRunContainerAdministrator::Logging
methods.description: Configures logging options for container management.
